contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B001/F001: bodily sight and seeing-capable status
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The concrete phrase مِنْ مَسَاكِنِهِمْ supplies visible remains independently of the closing participle.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: Their available seeing can coexist with the later failure to follow the way.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: The ruins are something observable, so failure is not simply absence of visual access.
contact_opportunities.containment: Secondary sensory facet of the focus word; keep inward insight and sensory sight distinct.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B002/F001: inward knowing and verified understanding
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The closing established-state grammar is independently opposed to the clear dwelling evidence and the diversion result.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: They are diverted while inward discernment is available.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: The paradox shifts from blindness to discernment that fails to govern action.
contact_opportunities.containment: HFT-derived qualified contact; preserve legacy_unbound provenance and do not reduce the word to a single spiritual gloss.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B002/F002: proof-bearing discernment and evidence
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The independent opening تَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ مِنْ مَسَاكِنِهِمْ explicitly supplies proof and explanatory disclosure.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: The closing sight word can resonate with discernment of evidence, not only private perception.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: The failure includes available proof that does not become action-guiding understanding.
contact_opportunities.containment: Bounded secondary facet of bṣr in the focus packet; no free 'proof' translation for the participle.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B004/F001: becoming visible and intelligible
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The source phrase from the dwellings and the addressed audience independently anchor self-manifesting clarity.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: The evidence emerges from the remains rather than being imposed by a named explainer.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: The ruins disclose themselves as readable proof.
contact_opportunities.containment: Focus-ayah Form V contact; retains self-manifestation rather than causative explanation.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B004/F003: open proof or evidentiary sign
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: لَكُمْ مِنْ مَسَاكِنِهِمْ independently frames the dwellings as evidence addressed to witnesses.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: The former homes become legible signs after destruction.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: Place is converted into testimony.
contact_opportunities.containment: HFT-derived proof facet; retain its exploratory synthesis and analogical limit.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B002/F001: settling in a place and living there
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The possessive plural dwelling noun is independently tied to the evidence verb as the settled sites from which proof comes.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: The evidence is concretely located in places where the peoples lived.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: Settled habitation becomes the material basis of the evidence gap.
contact_opportunities.containment: HFT-derived settled-site contact; exact Arabic anchors surface contact, while the synthesis remains qualified.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B002/F002: the inhabited home or place as concrete locus
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The source preposition and possessive suffix independently make the plural locations the physical source of clarity.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: The dwellings are not only an abstract act of inhabiting but actual places that can be encountered.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: The evidence has a material location.
contact_opportunities.containment: Focus-ayah lexical-syntactic contact; does not activate household occupants or legal renting facets.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B001/F001: settled motion becoming still
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The ruined dwelling scene independently supplies halted settlement around the place noun.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: The dwellings can be read as the still remains of once-living habitation.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: The word holds present stillness alongside former dwelling.
contact_opportunities.containment: Focus-ayah exploratory lexical pressure, bounded to the ruin image.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B001/F001: stability reversed into halted testimony
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The destruction frame and survival of the dwellings independently turn settlement's stabilizing function into evidence.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: What once enabled staying now remains after the occupants as a sign against permanence.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: The material technology of settlement becomes testimony.
contact_opportunities.containment: Qualified HFT settlement synthesis; distinct from the narrower noun-level stillness finding.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B009/F002: people's places and settled positions
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The possessive plural and source-of-clarity relation independently identify the locations as the peoples' settled places.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: The sites preserve the occupants' former positions after the occupants are gone.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: Location itself survives as witness.
contact_opportunities.containment: Qualified HFT settlement contact; bounded to place/location, not a special place name.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B002/F001: making beauty visible
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The direct object of deeds and the following result independently identify active beautification.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: Their practices are made attractive before the diversion occurs.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: Moral appearance is engineered as the first causal step.
contact_opportunities.containment: Qualified HFT valuation contact; not a natural-beauty or star-adornment reading.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B001/F001: traversable road or route
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The obstruction verb and separation preposition independently target a path that can be traversed.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: The route continues to exist while access to it is disrupted.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: Diversion is spatialized as interference with a course.
contact_opportunities.containment: Qualified HFT valuation contact; physical route image remains compatible with moral-way pressure.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B001/F003: way toward rightness or rescue
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The known definite path is the object of being turned away from in the Satan/deception frame.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: The obstruction is removal from a recognized moral course, not only from terrain.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: The reader hears spiritual direction in the ordinary path frame.
contact_opportunities.containment: Secondary moral-way facet; do not erase the simultaneous physical course image.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B001/F001: remoteness and estrangement
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The explicit away-from path frame supplies independent distance from a route.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: The named adversary's associated distance pressure coheres with the produced separation.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: The agent's action carries an image of estrangement from the course.
contact_opportunities.containment: Exploratory root pressure only; proper-agent meaning remains primary.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B004/F001: unruly rebellious adversarial being
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The definite nominative subject independently supplies the named agent and its active beautifying role.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: The adversary is a concrete operator of valuation distortion, not an unnamed force.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: Agency remains visible while the people remain active in their deeds.
contact_opportunities.containment: Qualified HFT valuation contact; preserves adversarial-entity boundary and source qualification.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B001/F002: actively barring another from a course
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The attached object and governed path independently select transitive obstruction.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: The named peoples are acted upon by a completed bar from the route.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: The sentence preserves both agentive obstruction and affected people.
contact_opportunities.containment: Qualified HFT valuation contact; exact local form selects transitive use rather than the intransitive facet.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B012/F001: old tribe proper-name use
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The paired ethnonyms and recovered destruction governance independently identify ʿAd as the named old people.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: The proper name carries a concrete people into the shared ruin evidence frame.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: The first name is a historical referent, not an unconnected sound string.
contact_opportunities.containment: Focus-ayah proper-name contact; no free return-verb reading is implied.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B001/F001: return and renewed direction
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The destruction opening, recognized way, and final diversion independently form a failed-return setting.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: The name's return pressure colors the absence of return to the way.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: A faint no-return irony becomes available without changing the name's referent.
contact_opportunities.containment: Exploratory proper-name pressure; not a lexical gloss and not a historical etymology claim.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B001/F001: knowingly produced action or deed
contact_opportunities.independent_trigger: The plural possessed object is independently acted on by beautification and followed by diversion.
contact_opportunities.changed_reading: The people's purposive conduct remains theirs even as its evaluation is distorted.
contact_opportunities.reader_payoff: Agency is captured through revaluation rather than deleted.

contact_opportunities.distinctive_facet: B001/F001: established being or state

accepted_findings.title: Dwelling becomes still ruin testimony
accepted_findings.claim: مَسَاكِنِهِمْ can carry both former habitation and present stillness, so the remains testify through what has stopped.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The plural place noun is read in the supplied destruction setting, where habitation and stillness overlap without replacing the base dwelling sense.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ruins as active evidence of halted settlement, not just a location label.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah lexical pressure; exploratory root overlap, bounded to the dwelling noun and ruin context.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: The movement of a settled thing has come to rest.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The ruined dwelling context and the place noun's plural form supply an independent stillness image.
branch_contributions.contribution: The dwellings can be perceived as settlement whose movement and life have stopped.
branch_contributions.boundary: Do not turn the noun into a literal verb of stopping or erase its ordinary dwelling reference.

accepted_findings.title: Dwellings under source governance
accepted_findings.claim: The base reading makes the dwellings the governed source from which clarity comes, while a nominative alternative keeps a stronger agency pressure visible.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The genitive plural place noun follows مِنْ in the base parse; the supplied variant does not displace that parse.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish where evidence comes from from the more forceful possibility that the places themselves clarify.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah syntax; base attachment is primary and the nominative variant is a contained alternative.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: A settled home or place is the named site of dwelling.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The source preposition and the possessive suffix make the sites concrete evidentiary places.
branch_contributions.contribution: The evidence is located in actual settled places, not in an abstract claim detached from them.
branch_contributions.boundary: The branch contributes concrete place imagery, not a claim about household occupants or rental law.

accepted_findings.title: Surviving dwellings remain as witness
accepted_findings.claim: The dwellings recur as readable witnesses after destruction rather than functioning as neutral scenery.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The local source phrase is reinforced by the supplied dwelling-survival recurrences.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader is directed to what remains visible after the people are gone.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah recurrence; supplied intertextual recurrence supports the witness function without importing an entire narrative.

accepted_findings.title: The evidence parenthesis reconnects to causation
accepted_findings.claim: The opening وَ pauses the carried name sequence for certified audience-facing evidence, and the later وَ resumes the causal downfall account.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The two conjunctions bracket an evidentiary aside without severing the named peoples from the later mechanism.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The ayah reads as one movement: names, visible proof, then the cause of diversion.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah discourse structure; the circumstantial/resumptive nuance remains live.

accepted_findings.title: Beautification exposes its three roles
accepted_findings.claim: The active Form II verb separates the beautifying agent, the affected recipients, and the deeds made attractive.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The subject, lām phrase, and direct object are all grammatically recoverable around زَيَّنَ.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The deception is represented as an operation with an agent and targets, not as an anonymous change of opinion.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah valency and attachment; no claim that the grammar alone proves a complete theology of agency.

accepted_findings.title: Moral judgment is worked over as appearance
accepted_findings.claim: Form II beautification turns the deeds into an attractive surface before the path obstruction occurs.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The intensive active form acts on the plural deed object and makes presentation the first stage of the mechanism.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees downfall beginning through altered valuation rather than brute force alone.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah morphology and object relation; the adornment image remains a local mechanism, not a free visual metaphor.

accepted_findings.title: Beautification leads into obstruction
accepted_findings.claim: The named adversary and beautified deeds belong to a supplied recurring pattern in which attractive presentation leads to path obstruction.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The local clause supplies both the beautification and its result, while the supplied recurrence supplies the formulaic pressure.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes diversion as the consequence of a valuation mechanism, not a separate unexplained event.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah formula recurrence; recurrence supports the local relation but does not force every neighboring occurrence into this ayah.

accepted_findings.title: For them becomes against them
accepted_findings.claim: The lām phrase routes beautification toward the peoples as apparent beneficiaries, yet the following result shows that the benefit is harmful affectedness.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The prepositional recipient and direct deed object remain distinct, and the result clause reverses the apparent benefactive direction.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The grammatical route of the attraction itself carries the irony of self-harming appeal.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah syntax and local consequence; this is an affectedness reversal, not a claim that لِ always means harm.

accepted_findings.title: One plural group persists through the mechanism
accepted_findings.claim: The bound plural pronoun keeps the named peoples together as possessors of ruins, recipients of beautification, owners of deeds, and objects of diversion.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The same 3MP referent recurs across different grammatical roles.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader does not lose the continuity between the ruins and the people who are later diverted.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah reference tracking; pronoun continuity does not erase the individual names or their formal differences.

accepted_findings.title: The adversary is named and made subject
accepted_findings.claim: ٱلشَّيْطَانُ is a definite nominative subject, so the beautifying agency is explicitly named rather than left anonymous.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Case and attachment expose the agent before the deed object and result clause.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see who operates the attractive distortion in the sentence's causal chain.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah grammar; the named-agent reading is primary, with root-etymological pressure kept separate.

accepted_findings.title: The named adversary carries a bounded distance pressure
accepted_findings.claim: The adversary's remoteness association coheres with the later movement away from the recognized way, but remains a secondary coloring.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The root-pressure support comes from the explicitly separated path frame, while the local noun still selects the known adversarial agent.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader may hear distance operating in the agent's action without mistaking etymological pressure for the whole lexical gloss.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah exploratory pressure; do not replace the proper agent name with a free verb meaning 'to distance'.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: The adversarial name can carry the image of remoteness.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The explicit عَنِ السَّبِيلِ frame supplies separation from a route independently of the name's root association.
branch_contributions.contribution: The one associated with distance operates in a scene where distance from the way is produced.
branch_contributions.boundary: This is background root pressure only; the local lexical identity is the named adversarial agent.

accepted_findings.title: Their deeds form an owned practice field
accepted_findings.claim: أَعْمَالَهُمْ names a plural owned body of actions; its local danger comes from having that whole field made attractive.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The broad action root, plural form, possessive suffix, and direct-object role gather practice into one evaluative object.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader avoids the shortcut that the noun itself means evil and instead sees moral danger in the revaluation of agency.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah lexical and syntactic reading; neutral action semantics are preserved under the local negative sequence.

accepted_findings.title: The deeds are the hinge into diversion
accepted_findings.claim: The collected deeds are first beautified and then sit immediately before the result that turns the people from the way.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Clause order and the following fa make the deed object the transition point between valuation and movement.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees how action remains theirs while its evaluation becomes the route into obstruction.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah clause sequence; this is a local hinge, not a claim that the deed noun alone encodes diversion.

accepted_findings.title: Fa makes obstruction the immediate result
accepted_findings.claim: The causal-sequential فَ presents path obstruction as the direct and close consequence of beautification.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The result relation follows the beautification clause and preserves sequence as well as causality.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: Diversion is read as produced by the preceding attraction, not as an unrelated second fact.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah connective syntax; the particle's result force is local and does not erase broader coordination possibilities.

accepted_findings.title: The way remains while access is blocked
accepted_findings.claim: The completed transitive obstruction acts on the peoples and turns them away from a specific intact path.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The attached object, separation preposition, and governed definite noun form one directional obstruction frame.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader understands blockage of access and orientation, not destruction or disappearance of the way.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah grammar and lexical frame; the variant and broader root ranges do not displace the base transitive reading.

accepted_findings.title: Obstruction of the way is a recurring frame
accepted_findings.claim: The local beautification-result sequence joins a supplied recurring obstruction-plus-way collocation.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Formula recurrence and same-surah route links reinforce the local pairing of diversion with the recognized path.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears a conventional route-obstruction image rather than a generic statement of moral failure.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah recurrence; the formula supports the local reading without making recurrence a substitute for local syntax.

accepted_findings.title: The path carries course and flow pressure
accepted_findings.claim: The definite path can be felt as a proper course whose natural flow is interfered with, while the local sense remains way or route.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The root range supplies course and letting-fall imagery; عَنِ and صَدَّ make obstruction feel like interference with that course.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader gets a physical route image without turning السَّبِيلِ into an unsupported verb of pouring.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah exploratory root pressure, narrowly contained to the path image.

accepted_findings.title: The target is the recognized singular way
accepted_findings.claim: ٱلسَّبِيلِ is definite and singular, so the obstruction targets the known proper course rather than one optional route.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Definiteness, number, genitive governance, and the obstruction collocation converge on a recognized way.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees a known route made inaccessible, not a vague failure to find any path.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah morphology and syntax; physical and moral route readings remain compatible.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: A way directed toward rightness, goodness, or rescue is a specialized path use.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The path is the governed target of being turned away from, and the Satan/deception frame supplies the moral direction.
branch_contributions.contribution: The obstruction can be heard as removal from a recognized moral way, not merely from a road surface.
branch_contributions.boundary: This contribution does not exclude the physical course facet, which is carried separately.

accepted_findings.title: The final conjunction sharpens the despite-clause
accepted_findings.claim: The closing وَ joins the insight state to the obstruction so that being diverted is heard against the fact of insight.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Local attachment and discourse contrast make the final clause concessive in force even though the conjunction remains formally coordinative.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The closing paradox is grammatical: they are diverted while described through insight.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah discourse relation; concessive force is contextual rather than a claim that وَ has a fixed lexical meaning of 'although'.

accepted_findings.title: Insight is an established plural state
accepted_findings.claim: كَانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ presents the two peoples as already occupying an insight-related state at the point of diversion.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The perfect plural auxiliary carries the opening doublet into an accusative participial predicate.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The obstruction cannot be explained simply as absence of perceptual capacity.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah morphology and reference continuity; the state is heightened but its exact degree remains qualified.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: Being or existing in an established state is the core auxiliary pressure.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The perfect auxiliary governs the final participle and sets it as an already-held condition.
branch_contributions.contribution: The insight state is presented as existing before and during the diversion.
branch_contributions.boundary: This is a state-setting contribution, not a separate location or submission meaning of the root.

accepted_findings.title: The standing-state form echoes into 29:39
accepted_findings.claim: The auxiliary-plus-participle construction in this ayah has a bounded structural echo in the next ayah's failed-escape description.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The supplied immediate recurrence creates a local cross-ayah pattern while the present ayah remains the focus.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the neighboring ayahs answer each other through established states and their failure.
accepted_findings.containment: Pericope-local recurrence only; 29:39 is an echo, not a replacement for the focus ayah's claim.

accepted_findings.title: The plural auxiliary keeps the doublet active
accepted_findings.claim: The third masculine plural form keeps ʿAd and Thamud as the unrenamed subject at the ayah's close.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Plural agreement carries the coordinated names through the evidence aside and back into the final state.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader remains aware that the final insight paradox applies to the same paired peoples.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah agreement and discourse continuity.

accepted_findings.title: Bodily fall meets cognitive sight
accepted_findings.claim: The supplied boundary evidence supports a qualified contrast between destroyed bodily existence and the final participle's cognitive or perceptual language.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The prior bodily image and closing insight state are placed at the ayah boundary as counter-poles.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony that physical ruin and available understanding can coexist.
accepted_findings.containment: Exploratory boundary reading based only on supplied packet evidence; it does not add an unsupplied body-versus-mind doctrine.

accepted_findings.title: Form X keeps insight semantically open
accepted_findings.claim: مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ heightens the perceptual range but leaves possession, seeking, and even claimed insight as qualified alternatives rather than maximal certainty.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Form X participial morphology and final position intensify the state while the supplied lexical range prevents reduction to eyesight alone.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the closing word is stronger than a flat 'they understood' while remaining careful about its exact degree.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah Form X reading; exploratory range retained, with sensory and inward facets separated.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: The bodily sight branch supplies the possible seeing-capable reading.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The concrete visible dwellings and the closing perceptual participle independently support a sight-facing facet.
branch_contributions.contribution: The peoples may have had visible sight available while the ayah describes their diversion.
branch_contributions.boundary: This does not turn the word into the ordinary noun for an eye or into a claim that sensory sight is the only reading.

accepted_findings.title: A rare inverse insight echo remains visible
accepted_findings.claim: The supplied 7:201 recurrence creates an inverse pattern: adversarial contact there leads toward remembering and seeing, while this ayah places adversarial beautification beside insight that does not govern action.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The rare participial recurrence and opposed local outcomes supply the contrast.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices a tension between perception as recovery and perception that fails to direct conduct.
accepted_findings.containment: Exploratory cross-ayah recurrence; the relation is an analogy of direction and must not be treated as a lexical gloss.

accepted_findings.title: The participle classifies both peoples
accepted_findings.claim: The accusative active participle functions as the shared predicate of the plural peoples under كَانُوا.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Attachment evidence fixes the grammatical predicate and the final clause relation supplies its paradoxical placement.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees a standing classification of the two peoples rather than a late isolated act.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah grammar; the participle's lexical degree remains open as recorded elsewhere.

accepted_findings.title: The ayah closes a clarity-versus-failure envelope
accepted_findings.claim: Audience-facing clarity from the dwellings and final insight language form one envelope in which evidence and perceptual capacity are available while conduct is diverted.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The opening evidence clause and closing concessive participle are linked by the local causal narrative.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader's question shifts from 'could they know?' to 'why did knowing not govern their way?'
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah synthesis; it preserves the local contrast without claiming that every semantic facet of bṣr is simultaneously active.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: The insight branch extends toward evidence, proof, and explanatory discernment.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The independent opening تَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ مِنْ مَسَاكِنِهِمْ supplies explicit evidence and audience-facing clarification.
branch_contributions.contribution: The closing insight word can resonate with proof-bearing discernment, making the failure a failure to govern action with available evidence.
branch_contributions.boundary: This is a bounded secondary facet, not a claim that the participle itself means 'proof' in isolation.

accepted_findings.title: The opening wa carries a prior frame
accepted_findings.claim: The ayah begins as continuation: the first conjunction carries the named peoples into a recovered destruction frame.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The opening connector precedes the accusative name sequence and does not reset the narrative.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader receives the names as the next beat of an ongoing judgment rather than a detached list.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah boundary syntax; the recovered governance is supplied as a frame, not an invented missing sentence.

accepted_findings.title: ʿAd is a carried accusative name
accepted_findings.claim: عَادًۭا is a fully declinable accusative carried object under the recovered opening frame.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Tanwin and case mark the name's syntactic dependence beside the paired proper name.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The name-list is heard as grammatically governed action, not as an unconnected heading.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah morphology; the root return pressure is not used as a free verb meaning.

accepted_findings.title: The names form a destroyed-peoples doublet
accepted_findings.claim: ʿAd and Thamud are compressed into one paired object frame whose later dwellings jointly become visible evidence.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Coordination, shared governance, and the supplied destruction recurrences bind the proper names.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader expects the evidence clause to address both named peoples together.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah proper-name pairing and supplied recurrence; this does not flatten the two names' formal differences.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: The old tribe's proper-name use is the actual ethnonymic carrier.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The coordinated Thamud name and shared destruction frame independently identify the name as one member of the old-tribe pair.
branch_contributions.contribution: The opening names a concrete destroyed people whose dwellings later serve as evidence.
branch_contributions.boundary: This is the proper-name reading, not a free conversion of the name into a return verb.

accepted_findings.title: The ʿAd name carries cautious return irony
accepted_findings.claim: A faint return or recurrence pressure can color ʿAd in a scene where return to the recognized way fails, but the proper name remains primary.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The name's root field meets the later path-diversion and failed-insight context.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader may hear a no-return irony without being told that the ethnonym literally means return here.
accepted_findings.containment: Exploratory proper-name root pressure; not a lexical gloss and not a claim about historical etymology.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: The root branch carries return and renewed action after departure.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The opening destruction frame, later recognized way, and final diversion independently create a failed-return setting.
branch_contributions.contribution: The name can be heard against the possibility of return to a proper course that does not occur.
branch_contributions.boundary: The proper ethnonym and its historical reference remain primary; the return image is only background pressure.

accepted_findings.title: The second wa locks the pair
accepted_findings.claim: The second conjunction binds Thamud to ʿAd under one carried frame while preserving a compact opening cadence.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Coordination and the adjacent case behavior make the two names one syntactic beat.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears a paired judgment rather than two unrelated historical mentions.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah coordination and cadence.

accepted_findings.title: Thamud carries a cautious depletion coloring
accepted_findings.claim: The Thamud name can carry a faint exhausted-resource image beside the visible remains, but remains a proper name.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The supplied root pressure meets the local dwelling-and-ruin evidence without controlling the parse.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader may sense depletion behind the surviving settlement evidence without replacing the ethnonym.
accepted_findings.containment: Exploratory proper-name coloring only; no free water-exhaustion gloss.

accepted_findings.title: Thamud's diptote shape remains audible
accepted_findings.claim: The base form ثَمُودَ shares the accusative role but does not take the first name's tanwin, while a supplied leveling variant remains live.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Diptote morphology creates a formal asymmetry inside the otherwise paired opening.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear both syntactic pairing and non-identical nominal behavior.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah form and variant evidence; no semantic difference is forced by the variant.

accepted_findings.title: Thamud brings visible dwelling history

accepted_findings.title: Qad certifies realized clarity
accepted_findings.claim: قَدْ places certification before the perfect clarity verb, presenting the evidence as established rather than tentative.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Particle placement prepares the completed Form V event.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The audience is addressed with settled evidence, not a possibility still awaiting proof.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah particle and aspect; certification does not by itself specify the evidence's content.

accepted_findings.title: Clarity is already realized
accepted_findings.claim: The perfect Form V verb presents broad evidence as already clear to the addressed audience from the dwellings.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Perfect aspect, broad event attachment, and the source phrase make clarity an accomplished state.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The later failure cannot be reduced to an absence of available evidence.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah aspect and attachment; the broad subject is not narrowed to a single isolated fact.

accepted_findings.title: The evidence discloses itself
accepted_findings.claim: Form V lets clarity emerge from the evidence itself rather than from a named explanatory agent.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: The thing becomes visible, intelligible, and clear.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The dwellings are the source from which clarity has already emerged for the audience.

branch_contributions.boundary: The branch contributes self-manifesting clarity, not a speech or writing act.

accepted_findings.title: The audience receives the evidence
accepted_findings.claim: لَكُمْ makes the addressed hearers grammatical recipients and accountable witnesses of the disclosure.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The dative lām routes the clarity event toward second-person listeners.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The ancient remains are turned into evidence presented to the current audience.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah address syntax; accountability is a discourse payoff, not an extra lexical sense of the suffix.

accepted_findings.title: The source attachment remains primary but not solitary
accepted_findings.claim: مِنْ مَسَاكِنِهِمْ most naturally makes the dwellings the source of clarity, while a supplied modifying/agency attachment remains a controlled alternative.
accepted_findings.mechanism: Local attachment evidence strongly favors the source reading; the variant changes how directly the dwellings act as clarifiers.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader retains a real grammatical ambiguity without losing the base parse.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah attachment ambiguity; the alternative is contained and does not create a second unrestricted reading.

accepted_findings.title: Place becomes an evidence channel
accepted_findings.claim: The source preposition makes the dwellings the medium or origin from which the audience's clarity comes.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The preposition connects the governed place noun to the clarity verb and keeps evidence materially located.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices that place itself carries the proof.
accepted_findings.containment: Focus-ayah prepositional syntax; source, medium, and sufficient-sample nuances remain bounded variants of the same local relation.

accepted_findings.title: Available evidence and available discernment do not govern action
accepted_findings.claim: The ayah places clear external evidence and an available inward perceptual capacity on either side of diversion; seeing does not become governing commitment.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The HFT synthesis connects the disclosure from dwellings and the closing insight state to the intervening obstruction.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader understands the failure as a gap between evidence/capacity and conduct, not simply as blindness.
accepted_findings.containment: Qualified HFT synthesis with exact focus-ayah anchor; source is legacy_unbound and broader-than-declared-pericope, so this is exploratory and not a lexical gloss.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: Knowing, inward penetration, and verified understanding.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The established closing participle is independently opposed to the already-clear dwelling evidence and the following diversion.
branch_contributions.contribution: The peoples are portrayed as having discernment available even though it does not govern their movement.
branch_contributions.boundary: This is the inward-discernment branch in a qualified synthesis, not a claim that the word has only a spiritual sense.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: Becoming visible, intelligible, and clear.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The source phrase مِنْ مَسَاكِنِهِمْ and the audience dative independently anchor manifest disclosure.
branch_contributions.contribution: The external evidence has become clear from the settled remains before the account turns to deception.
branch_contributions.boundary: The branch supplies disclosure, not a claim that the verb is causative speech.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: Settling in a place and living there.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The plural possessive dwelling noun independently supplies concrete settled sites as the source of disclosure.
branch_contributions.contribution: The places where the peoples lived become the material medium through which evidence is available.
branch_contributions.boundary: The branch contributes settled-site imagery, not a claim about every possible household sense of the root.

accepted_findings.title: Attractive valuation captures active agency
accepted_findings.claim: Diversion is mediated by attractive revaluation of the peoples' own purposive deeds: they keep acting while their relation to a traversable way is rerouted.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The HFT synthesis links beautification, named adversarial agency, owned deeds, transitive diversion, and the path target in the local order.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees an action-loop whose agency is captured through appearance rather than erased by an external block.
accepted_findings.containment: Qualified HFT synthesis with exact focus-ayah anchor; source is legacy_unbound and broader-than-declared-pericope, with branch payload retained as attributed nomination and not as lexical proof.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: A thing is beautified and its beauty is made visible.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The direct deed object and the following result clause independently anchor active beautification.
branch_contributions.contribution: The deeds are made attractive before the people are diverted.
branch_contributions.boundary: The branch contributes beautification as mechanism, not a claim about natural greening or stars.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: An unruly, rebellious, evil being.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The definite nominative agent and its beautifying action independently identify the named adversary.
branch_contributions.contribution: The valuation distortion has a named rebellious agent.
branch_contributions.boundary: The branch is the local adversarial-entity image, not every etymological or zoological extension.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: A knowingly produced act or deed.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The plural possessed object and its beautification independently make intentional conduct the medium of capture.
branch_contributions.contribution: Their own purposive deeds remain active in the mechanism.
branch_contributions.boundary: The action root remains morally broad; local danger comes from its revaluation.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: Transitive turning or barring another from an activity.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The attached object and the following عَنِ السَّبِيلِ independently select transitive diversion.
branch_contributions.contribution: The agent actively bars the peoples from the path while they remain the acted-on group.
branch_contributions.boundary: The exact local transitive use is retained; the intransitive facet is not being claimed.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: A physical road or a way toward an end.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The definite path noun governed after the obstruction verb independently supplies a traversable course.
branch_contributions.contribution: The route is still there; what changes is their access and orientation toward it.
branch_contributions.boundary: The branch contributes route imagery; moral-way specialization is recorded separately.

accepted_findings.title: Settlement outlasts its occupants as testimony
accepted_findings.claim: The instruments and places of settlement survive precisely as evidence against the permanence their former occupants inhabited.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The HFT synthesis reverses settlement/stability into manifest ruin testimony by joining the dwelling, stillness, and disclosure branches.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the remains as a reversal of settlement: what once stabilized life now exposes its failure.
accepted_findings.containment: Qualified HFT synthesis with exact focus-ayah anchor; source is legacy_unbound and broader-than-declared-pericope, with the root images kept analogical and bounded.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: An open proof, sign, or document made evident.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The explicit audience-facing source phrase independently makes the former dwellings evidentiary signs.
branch_contributions.contribution: The settled places are legible testimony after the people disappear.
branch_contributions.boundary: This is a proof-sign extension of the clarity branch, not a claim that every document sense is active.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: Movement ends and a thing passes into stillness.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The ruin setting and surviving places independently reverse the settling image into halted life.
branch_contributions.contribution: The dwelling's stabilizing function becomes still evidence against permanence.
branch_contributions.boundary: The stillness is a bounded image in context, not a literal verbal tense.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: A plural expression can name people's places, homes, and settled positions.
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The possessive plural and source attachment independently identify the locations as the peoples' settled places.
branch_contributions.contribution: Their places outlast them as the material locus of testimony.
branch_contributions.boundary: The branch contributes location and settled position, not a special place-name reading.

friction_notes: The مِنْ مَسَاكِنِهِمْ attachment is primarily a source-of-clarity relation, but the supplied nominative/modifying alternative remains a real bounded pressure; keep it visible without flattening the base parse.
The ʿAd return pressure and Thamud depletion pressure are proper-name colorings only. They are narrowed and must not be rendered as free lexical translations.
The closing وَ is formally coordinative but has a supplied concessive landing; the standing insight state is strong, while its exact semantic degree remains open across sensory and inward facets.

The three HFT nominations are accepted as qualified exploratory syntheses with exact focus anchors. Their legacy_unbound provenance and broader-than-declared-pericope containment limit certainty, not visibility.

The focus-root occurrence candidates are rejected only as independent findings because their ledger_only obligation supplies carrier proof without an independent facet-trigger-payoff chain; their roots remain covered by the branch screen and accepted contacts where applicable.
The prefatory basmala is referred to a context lane because automatic surah membership does not make 29:0 a local carrier in 29:38.
